title: Lower Broadway 2700sq ft/4BR, Walkable to Broadway
description:
Walk to Broadway from the ultimate Nashville getaway in this luxurious 2700 sq ft Lower Broadway Suite! Ideal for bachelor/bachelorette gatherings, special occasions, corporate retreats, executive getaway or business meetings. Steps from the vibrant Broadway scene, this apartment offers four spacious bedrooms and four bathrooms. Enjoy modern amenities and immerse yourself in the heart of Nashville's music and entertainment district. Perfect for groups seeking an unforgettable stay.

The space
Experience luxury in our 2,700 sq ft apartment, featuring four beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom. Enjoy endless entertainment with a dedicated game area, complete with a pool table and a selection of cards and board games.

Guest access
Main entrance is at 200 6th Ave N.

Other things to note
Please note: There's a downtown grocery store, the Savi Urban Market, within walking distance for your convenience. You'll also find a Whole Foods and Publix, both about a mile away.
If you have any questions, just message us anytime! Happy to help!
